title: kith-tui: follows non-https session URLs
description: main.rs requires --url https://, but kith-tui then follows apiUrl and eventSourceUrl from the Session as given. jmap-testjig behind a TLS proxy advertises http://127.0.0.1:8080/jmap, so every API call and the SSE stream (with the bearer token) go over plain HTTP, silently bypassing --cert pinning. Decide: reject non-https session URLs (testjig would then need a URL-rewriting TLS proxy) or accept loopback-only http. Not changed in KITH-1ln3.
close_reason: Refuse to start unless apiUrl and (expanded) eventSourceUrl are https:// (RFC 8620 §1.7). No same-origin check: RFC 8620 §2 allows URLs elsewhere; --cert pinning bounds hosts. kith-tui does not use download/upload URLs. testjig now needs a URL-rewriting proxy or https URLs.
